svg.aria-label: Atlantic DWBC principal corridor reference length
svg.text: Atlantic DWBC principal corridor reference length
Declared principal geographic routes · WGS84 length estimates · nominal paths shown
Deep Western Boundary: ≈ 15,300 km · sensitivity 15,300–15,500 km
Source: Dengler2004 and retained regional studies. Geographic corridor includes conceptual eddy-mediated connections.
36 cases per current clear coarse land. Fine coast unchecked. Sensitivity is not annual variation.
